reason: Verified that the "QA-20260917-193652-qrpj" agent successfully received a message asking "What is 2+2?" and responded with the correct answer "4".
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Page loaded successfully displaying the Gamut home page with agent list including QA-20260917-193652-qrpj in idle state.
Clicked on "QA-20260917-193652-qrpj" agent in the sidebar — Successfully navigated to the agent's detail page showing agent configuration, message input field, and idle status.
Verified agent status is "idle" — Confirmed the agent status indicator displayed "idle" in the top right corner of the page.
Clicked on the message input field — Input field became active and ready for text entry.
Typed the message "Hello! What is 2+2?" — Message successfully entered into the input field and displayed in the textbox.
Clicked the Send message button — Message was submitted and the application navigated to a new chat session titled "Basic Math Question Session" with the agent status changing to "working".
Waited for agent response — Agent processed the message (status showed "working" with activity indicator). Response appeared on screen within seconds.
Verified the response contains "4" — The agent responded with "4", the correct answer to the math question 2+2=4, displayed on the left side of the message list. Agent status returned to "idle".
Took screenshot of the conversation — Final screenshot shows the complete conversation with user message "Hello! What is 2+2?" on the right and agent response "4" on the left.
